method: 既存原画を直接参照した画像生成
artDirection: Create one new premium narrative illustration for Dungeon of Souls, landscape 3:2 1536x1024. Treat the provided illustrations as binding art direction: exceptionally intricate fine pixel/dither texture with natural adult proportions, richly layered gothic dark fantasy illustration, tactile stone, carved wood, black iron, gold embroidery, dramatic but legible cool cyan/moonlight against warm amber candlelight, exquisite handcrafted details. Match the same character designs and clothes, architecture and rendering quality precisely. This must be a finished standalone full-bleed illustration, not a collage, no text, no border, no UI. Keep storytelling focal objects readable at 384x256. Hands anatomically correct thumb plus four fingers, exactly two arms per character.

images.title: 二人が降りた綱
images.prompt: Deep underground root-covered vertical shaft. Foreground left, the same young brown-haired apprentice in black cloak with gold embroidery and leather satchel examines an old rope securely tied in a distinctive sailor's knot around a massive root; nearby a small parchment with two different handwritten marks (no readable text), cyan soul lantern. Rope descends into luminous mist. Exactly four wooden humanoid companions with rounded wooden heads and black iron joints: red-cloaked warrior begins descent, white-robed priest, dark leather thief with dagger, purple-robed mage await on ledge. Strong vertical depth and intricate rope fibers, damp roots, moss. NOT two human climbers; 'two' refers to prior visitors Ordo and Sera.
